newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia sees 6-6.5 pct inflation in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia sees 6-6.5 pct inflation in 1996.

text.p: The head of Indonesia's Central Bureau of Statistics on Thursday predicted annual inflation at between six to 6.5 percent in calendar 1996.

"I think inflation will depend on how we can control food prices. If we can control food prices for the rest of the year, I think inflation will be between six to 6.5 percent this year," Sugito told reporters.
Indonesia's year-on-year inflation as measured by the consumer price index in October was 6.56 percent, compared with 6.79 percent in September.
Month-on-month inflation in October was 0.41 percent, compared with a decline of 0.04 percent in September.
Inflation in 1995 was 8.6 percent and cumulative inflation in the first ten months of this year is 5.35 percent.
